sections.title: What Is Drain Cleaning?
sections.subtitle: Understanding professional drain clog removal
content: Drain cleaning is the process of removing blockages, buildup and debris that prevent wastewater from flowing properly through plumbing systems.
Professional drain cleaning helps restore proper drainage and identifies possible underlying plumbing problems.
The correct cleaning method depends on the location, severity and cause of the blockage.
sections.highlight: Ignoring repeated drain problems may lead to larger plumbing issues and emergency repairs.

faqs.question: What causes clogged drains in Houston homes?
faqs.answer: Common causes include grease buildup, hair, soap residue, food waste, mineral deposits and debris inside plumbing lines.

faqs.question: When should I call a professional drain cleaner?
faqs.answer: You should request professional drain cleaning for recurring clogs, slow drainage, backups, bad odors or multiple blocked fixtures.

faqs.question: What methods are used for drain cleaning?
faqs.answer: Professional providers may use drain snaking, hydro jetting, inspections and other cleaning methods depending on the plumbing condition.

faqs.question: Can I prevent clogged drains?
faqs.answer: Proper disposal habits, drain covers, regular maintenance and early attention to slow drains can help reduce clogging problems.

faqs.question: Is hydro jetting safe for all pipes?
faqs.answer: Hydro jetting suitability depends on pipe condition and should be evaluated by a qualified plumbing professional.
